method: Sky screenshot of exact already-open independent control; unscaled analytical crop excluding application chrome. Red<190 distinguishes opaque green fill from JPEG ringing, not an opacity correction.
scope: 112 horizontal/vertical straight-edge cross-sections, including nonuniform and translated groups, at native reference 100%, DPR1. Arbitrary zoom, color/alpha and screen/print equivalence are not established by this JPEG capture.
